name: vanilla_sssl_swa_only_looping
authorization: Implement and try vanilla SSSL, two extra loops per S (three total); window left512 confirmed. Correctness, same-GPU speed, short NTP and restart only. No formal10B or W&B.
sharing: Q/K/V/O shared across the three passes within each S layer only. Different layer positions, including L layers, have independent weights.
recurrence: Each pass x=x+Attention(RMSNorm(x)); recompute QKV with unchanged RoPE positions. After the passes x=x+MLP(RMSNorm(x)). No detach, new gates, alpha, loop embeddings or new parameters.
implementation: Original pinned FA3 native-window attention, torch.compile per entire layer; serial unrolled passes, no claim of cross-pass FlashAttention fusion. Backbone initialization and MuonAdamW unchanged.
profile: ABCCBA: full vanilla, one-pass SSSL, three-pass SSSL, reverse. Each fresh process,20warmup40timed complete optimizer steps, fixed seed/data/32Ktokens. Common micro16/8/4 within90% of22GB.
restart: 25->exit85->fresh process->128 actual NTP steps; original305176-step LR horizon, local logging; weights deleted in worker, not returned.
hardware: Single full H100/H200, pinned FA3. Existing embedded FA2 path has no native-window support; not eligible for this gate.
limitations: Cached decoding explicitly rejected before cache mutation; requires per-pass caches.
Short diagnostic does not establish long-run quality.
Old128/128/full shared-attention implementation stays retired and old active checkpoints are rejected.
